items.title: 67260_Freddie Moore oral history interview
items.q: He asked me to sit in and sing something... But I never worked with Roy, though. I only sat in once in a while, you know.

ctx.x: Well, what we can establish is that you apparently were not playing with Roy Eldridge at Jimmy Ryan's during the summer of 1971, as John Chilton's Who's Who In Jazz asserts. Someone else was playing with Roy Eldridge, and so forth. But did you ever play with Roy Eldridge in the 1970's or even in the 1960's?

No. I used to go down there sometimes, the nights I wasn't working. He asked me to sit in and sing something, you know. He seemed to be more interested in my drumming than he was in my singing. Because he sings a little bit himself, you know. But I never worked with Roy, though. I only sat in once in a while, you know.
